notes.title: 🌴🚗 𝔽𝕌𝕃𝕃 ℝ𝔼𝕃𝔼𝔸𝕊𝔼 🏁🌴
notes.content:
Synthwave FURY is now out of Early Access, the release update has arrived!

https://i.imgur.com/zU929Pj.gif


 Fixes to how each car handles to improve user experience
 A new, better optimised system of handling police AI
 Helicopter (or UFO in Galactic map) enemies roaming each map
 Turrets in different areas of each map
 Traffic on all maps to weave through
 Bug fixes and quality of life changes here and there
 6 New achievements!
 3 new unique maps, as well as additions and changes to the 3 already in the game.


https://i.imgur.com/yUMAm07.png

Watch the release trailer here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y2zwwOJ6rvw&ab_channel=VirtualEdition

Thanks for reading and supporting our game! Don't forget to leave any feedback, suggestions or reviews you have, we read all of them and are always aiming to improve our games in the future!

notes.title: ℂ𝕆ℕ𝕋𝔼ℕ𝕋 𝕌ℙ𝔻𝔸𝕋𝔼 𝟙 🌴🏁🌴
notes.content:
The first Major Content Update for Synthwave FURY has arrived!

Before we go further we should mention that this update doesn't just bring with it the big content we list below but also a plethora of minor adjustments, bug-fixes and others keeping the game fresh and stable for you!

https://i.imgur.com/Mi03mi5.png

The first new map theme is here!
Get ready to start drifting the tight race-track turns of Fuji Sunset!


https://i.imgur.com/N9IUQjr.png

The game has been localised into 4 new languages with more on the way!


https://i.imgur.com/R8kD43b.png

The game now has full controller support!
This should mean that it is also compatible with platforms such as the SteamDeck, though we are incapable of testing that ourselves, we'd greatly appreciate any feedback on this if there are any issues!


https://i.imgur.com/XkZqxLx.gif

Next on the list for Synthwave FURY is:

 More optimisation & bugfixing
 New achievements
 More localisations (Italian, Polish, Turkish)
 New enemy variants
 Updates to the Rainbow Galactic theme
 Updates to the Fuji Sunset theme
 A new map theme!


Thanks for reading and don't forget to leave any feedback, suggestions or reviews you have! We read all of them and are always aiming to improve the game before we get to full release!
